title: A custom tag stays while the value stays a scalar, over two edits in one patch
notes: The tag is a local tag on a scalar, and the new value is still a scalar, so the tag stays (a kit convention). The second edit of the same node must change only that node's text: the neighbouring entries are untouched.

provenance.reference: A writer whose second edit of a shortened tagged scalar used stale offsets, deleted the next line and produced invalid YAML.
